title: The UNTHINKABLE is About to Happen to the Stock Market
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Spiking CDS on CoreWeave/Oracle is a doom loop from high yields; neoclouds need an Iran deal to lower funding costs.
Expects a deal roughly Oct 20-27 / before the election, which would ease yields and lift everything.
Hyperscaler spend, ~50 GW in 2027 and ASML deposits show the boom is early; a chip shortage, not a bubble pop, is next.
Expects DRAM price declines next year, good for chip designers.

calls.reason: Weekend Black Monday fear is premature; another euphoric rally ahead before an eventual AI bubble.
calls.quote: between now and then, there's another insane euphoric rally ahead of us

calls.condition: Lower if a US-Iran deal happens; higher if conflict resumes
calls.reason: Believes peak yields (~5.27) are in; an Iran deal would quickly ease yield fears.
calls.quote: So far, we did hit peak yields, which we talked about peak being about 527-ish

calls.reason: Forward P/E ~23 vs growth ~35 (PEG ~0.65); coming GPU shortage and lower RAM per GPU help Nvidia.
calls.quote: That puts them at about a 0.65 PEG

calls.reason: Contract liabilities jumped from 3.5B to 9.3B euros, signalling a backlog above Street expectations for chip tools.
calls.quote: There's no sign of a slowdown here.

calls.condition: Neoclouds keep suffering without an Iran deal; can win if a deal lowers funding costs
calls.reason: Most rate-sensitive, debt-funded build-out with a bad balance sheet; CDS spiking.
calls.quote: The neo clouds basically are untouchable with uh without an Iran deal.

notes: Date: listing says 2026-10-20, but the Black Monday weekend-fear reference suggests it may be Mon 2026-10-19. Hyperscalers (MSFT, META, AMZN) called "a go either way" (bullish) but not recorded as separate calls. ES call is general market sentiment, no levels given.
